name: Are You RV Safe?
overview: Love travelling this beautiful country of ours in an RV? Well you won’t want to miss this series, where we follow a caravanner, a 4WDer, and a motorhome owner as they put their knowledge to the test. With the expert guidance of John Eggenhuizen and Michael ‘Borgy’ Borg, these adventurers will face real-life RV safety challenges that test their skills and nerve. Who’s truly prepared for the open road? The journey starts now—don’t miss a moment of the action!
